presets.name: Slow sweep
presets.description: A low pass opening and closing over two bars.

presets.name: Wobble bass
presets.description: A warm, resonant low pass wobbling in eighth notes.

presets.name: Auto-wah
presets.description: A band pass that opens with each note you play.

presets.name: Acid squelch
presets.description: A resonant acid low pass, driven, that bites on each note.

presets.name: DJ sweep
presets.description: The DJ filter, a little to the low side: turn Sweep either way.

presets.name: Telephone
presets.description: A narrow, driven band of the voice, as down a phone line.

presets.name: Underwater
presets.description: A dark, slowly moving low pass.

presets.name: Sidechain pump
presets.description: Closes on each hit: choose the kick under Sidechain, and the pad breathes with it.

presets.name: Talking bass
presets.description: The vowel filter moving from a to o in time with the song.

presets.name: Comb resonator
presets.description: A comb tuned to a pitch, so drums ring like a metal tube.

presets.name: Lo-fi resample
presets.description: Resampling that folds the highs back into grit.

presets.name: Spinning filter
presets.description: The two sides drifting in and out of step, wide.

presets.name: Gentle warmth
presets.description: A soft, warm low pass with a little drive, to take the edge off.

presets.name: Gated chop
presets.description: A square wave opening the filter in sixteenths.

presets.name: Notch sweep
presets.description: A notch swept slowly through the sound.
